My brother is shorter than me.

units.text: El autobús es más lento que el metro, pero es más barato.

translation.en: The bus is slower than the subway, but it's cheaper.

units.text: En la ciudad hay más tráfico que en el campo.

translation.nl: In de stad is meer verkeer dan op het platteland.

en: There's less traffic in the city than in the country.
There's more noise in the city than in the country.
it: In città c'è meno traffico che in campagna.
In città c'è più rumore che in campagna.
nl: In de stad is minder verkeer dan op het platteland.
In de stad is meer lawaai dan op het platteland.

units.text: En el campo el aire es más limpio y hay más espacio.

translation.en: In the country the air is cleaner and there's more space.
translation.it: In campagna l'aria è più pulita e c'è più spazio.

en: In the country the air is dirtier and there's more space.

it: In campagna l'aria è più sporca e c'è più spazio.

units.text: Mi barrio no es tan tranquilo como tu pueblo.

translation.en: My neighborhood isn't as quiet as your town.

translation.nl: Mijn buurt is niet zo rustig als jouw dorp.

en: My neighborhood is quieter than your town.
My neighborhood isn't as noisy as your town.
it: Il mio quartiere è più tranquillo del tuo paese.
Il mio quartiere non è rumoroso come il tuo paese.
nl: Mijn buurt is rustiger dan jouw dorp.
Mijn buurt is niet zo lawaaierig als jouw dorp.

translation.en: There aren't as many people in the country as here.
translation.it: In campagna non c'è tanta gente quanto qui.
translation.nl: Op het platteland zijn niet zoveel mensen als hier.

en: There are more people in the country than here.
There isn't as much traffic in the country as here.
it: In campagna c'è più gente che qui.
In campagna non c'è tanto traffico quanto qui.
nl: Op het platteland zijn meer mensen dan hier.

units.text: Los domingos el metro está vacío, pero los lunes está lleno.

translation.en: On Sundays the subway is empty, but on Mondays it's full.

translation.nl: Op zondag is de metro leeg, maar op maandag is hij vol.

nl: Op zondag is de metro vol, maar op maandag is hij leeg.

Today was the worst day of the year.

Oggi è stato il giorno peggiore dell'anno.

parecerse a = assomigliare a: me parezco a mi papá

parecerse a = lijken op: me parezco a mi papá
